scenario: Regex capture binding per LREG.4.1 — `Event e where (device) = e.msg ~ /(?<device>\w+) triggered/` parses, validates and lowers. One named capture group, one binding name matching at position 0. Path: `dsc.parse.lgra_8_3_4_take_where`'s capture arm; the match gates as FN_REGEX_MATCH on the beta and `{device}` lowers to FN_REGEX_CAPTURE group 1 (`dsc.rete.lreg_4_1_capture_expr`).
rules_ds:
schema Event scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    msg: String mutable

rule parse_msg:
    Event e where (device) = e.msg ~ /(?<device>\w+) triggered/
->
    log info "device: {device}"
